text: The Politics window no longer opens with empty ratings the first time it is viewed after the game server refreshes its data.
Import and Export Storage no longer offer a "connect all your warehouses" button that the original game never had.
Import and export storage owners now see the automatic-buying option on their warehouse's supplies.
The Close/Open button in the building inspector now actually closes and reopens your facility.
On desktop, the search directory with towns, people, rankings and banks opens again from the More menu.
The Rebuild Links button in your profile, which did nothing, has been removed.
Changing a product's price from a factory's General tab now actually changes it, and both price sliders now show whether the change was saved.
